blocks.text: Seoul, South Korea—North Korea fired “around a dozen” short-range ballistic missiles off its east coast on Thursday, Seoul’s defense ministry said, less than a week after South Korea proposed talks over a growing border row. The launches follow a slew of recent weapons tests by Pyongyang, including a new precision-guided torpedo system and an intermediate-range hypersonic missile, both of which were said to employ AI technology. South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) said its military detected “around a dozen short-range ballistic missiles fired from the Wonsan area of North Korea towards the East Sea”, the body of water also known as […]...
